entries.359c795a71f767b0: The company analyzes that the logistics industry is in a harsh environment, with cargo flows generally sluggish and the full onset of the '2024 problem' driven by a shortage of truck drivers, along with continued rises in personnel and fuel costs. The company has a network of sales offices centered on Osaka, including Kobe, Tokyo, Atsugi, Toda and Koto, and is capturing increased volumes from existing customers, including food-related customers.
entries.4b0ef0206703abfc: Of operating revenue from external customers, the logistics business accounts for ¥9,581 million, about 85% of the total, the real estate business ¥1,342 million, and other businesses ¥318 million. Its strategy centers on expanding cargo handled and bases in the logistics business, and the issues also include redeveloping core bases, such as considering demolition of the aging warehouse at the Osaka Port Sales Office and strengthening of facility functions.

entries.54f8cb1f8e6290e5: Under the Sugimura Group Medium-Term Management Plan, which covers fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2026, the company is developing its business with the issues of expanding cargo handled, expanding bases, improving productivity, developing personnel and sustainability initiatives. Because the targets set in the plan were reached in the previous consolidated fiscal year, the company is now studying the formulation of a new medium-term management plan and says it will continue to address the issues of the current plan for the time being. Its management philosophy is: 'always anticipate customers' needs and meet their expectations,' 'contribute to society through logistics operations,' and 'return prosperity to shareholders and employees.'

entries.fe0af1b149cf3105: Since its founding in 1895, the company has operated warehouses centered on the Osaka Port area, and its feature is a group system that can handle storage, cargo handling, packaging and distribution processing, and transport in an integrated manner. Consolidated subsidiary Sugimura Unyu handles transport and packaging and distribution processing, and proposes logistics solutions that combine these with the company's warehouse operations.
